keywords: EIP-8081 记录 ACDC #187 决定
summary: Nethermind 客户端 2.0.0 正式发布，改变状态存储方式：归档节点从约 30 TB 降到约 2 TB，可自选保留的历史，新节点区块处理速度比上一版快 2 到 3 倍。EIP-8081 合并 ACDC #187 的决定。fede_intern 认为多数以太坊核心工程团队可能在三年内消失，引发对客户端资金的又一轮讨论。

items.title: Nethermind：客户端 2.0.0 发布
items.note: 23:14，归档节点从约 30 TB 降到约 2 TB，可选择保留的历史，新节点上区块处理比上一版快 2 到 3 倍。
items.note_en: 23:14, with archive nodes dropping from about 30 TB to about 2 TB, a choice of how much history to keep, and blocks processing 2 to 3 times faster than the previous release on a fresh node.

items.title_en: fede_intern: most engineering teams working on core Ethereum will disappear over the next 3 years
items.note_en: 19:37, because there is no real money or much status in it and AI is quickly changing what it takes to implement a client (the post is long, and only the visible part is cited here).

summary_en: Nethermind client 2.0.0 shipped with a new way of storing state: archive nodes drop from about 30 TB to about 2 TB, operators choose how much history to keep, and blocks process 2 to 3 times faster than the previous release on a fresh node. EIP-8081 merged the ACDC #187 decisions. fede_intern argued most Ethereum core engineering teams may disappear within three years, sparking another round of discussion on client funding.
